playback.processing: one fixed gain over the full recording; no cuts or filters

inspection.result: Full 684 x 567 field inspected at original magma scale. Much of the dense upper-frequency texture is reduced, especially the region above the main lower vowel bands; both voiced regions, lower harmonic structure and descending pitch remain. Narrow resonance ridges persist. Together with the rounded source-derivative trace and the near-unchanged no-turbulence field, this supports a contact-related contribution to the upper texture, not a proven cure of perceived mechanical timbre.
